race.description: Hkjc World Pool Paris Lane Stakes (L)
race.comment: Open race to finish a big day but it looks a lovely option for TEN COMMANDMENTS (11) who has been in work a long time but is racing better than ever. Thought he was a query on a good 4 at Ballarat but he was dominant winning the Golden Nugget and he gets a lovely draw, wet ground and no weight. He did beat HOME RULE (15) when they met earlier in the campaign, HOME RULE was a strong winner from the front in good time last start at Caulfield. He can give a sight again. CAFE MILLENIUM (2) had his chance here last time but ran well for third with a big weight. This is his pet track and trip but wet ground is a genuine concern. AMENABLE (4) ran well fresh for the new yard at Sandown Hillside and should strip fitter, wet ground shouldn't be an issue for him and he draws a nice middle alley. COTE ATLANTIQUE (5) beat home CAFE MILLENIUM here last time as a 40/1 hope and must have some claims.
